literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) reports a C-terminal Flag tag appended to the full-length ADAM15 coding sequence (pcDNA3.1-ADAM15-Flag). Per the topology landmarks, the C-terminus (residues 716–863) is entirely intracellular. The paper names no residue, no extracellular loop, and no N-terminal tag; 'appended to the coding sequence' unambiguously means C-terminal. Although the mature N-terminus (residue 18) is extracellular, topology-derivation to that terminus would contradict the paper's explicit description of a C-terminal construct. No extracellular surface tag site is supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: Flag tag appended C-terminally to full-length ADAM15; the C-terminus (residues 716–863) is intracellular per topology landmarks — not a surface tag site.
